short_description: The country where medieval charm meets modern life. Explore fairytale castles, taste world-famous beer, and wander through Prague.
full_description: Country of fairytale castles, ancient streets, and vibrant culture in the heart of Europe. Walk through Prague’s old town, taste world-famous beer, and feel the atmosphere of history blending with modern life.
